newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price rose to $18.94 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price rose to $18.94 last week.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes edged up to $18.94 per barrel last week from $18.60 the previous week, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year has averaged $20.99.
In February the basket price averaged $20.49, down from $23.19 in January and $23.51 in December, it said.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
